title: A Little Note Before You Begin

paragraphs: This booklet brings together step-by-step solutions to the October assessment questions and the Ministry textbook questions, along with the most important and challenging questions from our homework booklet.

After revising the lesson explanations, please review the following questions carefully. Take your time with each question, follow the steps thoughtfully, and give every idea the attention it deserves.
I believe in you and in the effort you put into learning. May this revision help you feel confident, prepared, and proud of your progress.
welcome.closing: Wishing you all the best, my dear students!
